title: Father's shoe factory career and mother working the line
summary: His father rose over 30 years to an executive in a shoe company, in charge of quality and styling, and his mother worked on a machine there to help the family income.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And my father was involved with a shoe factory, worked as an employee, and worked himself up over a period of 30 years to being an executive of that company.
And he was in charge of quality and design, to some degree, styling.
And my mother, from the time when I was very young, in order to help the family income, and in their desire to live better, she worked part of the time at the same place.
As a workperson, on a machine.
On a machine, on the line.
Right. And never thought anything about it. When they were able to get into a better financial position, she quit.
